info.title: resx-lint — .resx localization key validator
info.description: Validates .resx translation keys against XAML and C# usage. Auto-fixes duplicates, missing Designer.cs properties, and orphaned language keys. Includes Web UI dashboard and visual translation editor.

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Project root directory (where .xaml and .cs files live)

options.name: --resx-file
options.description: Path to the base .resx file (e.g. Resources/AppResources.resx)

options.name: --what-if
options.description: Preview changes without writing any files

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
EXIT CODES:
0  All OK
1  Auto-fixes applied — restart the build
2  Invalid parameters
3  Fatal errors (TRANS001, TRANS004)
